title: Animation Energy Transfer System
description: Kira and a horse share a finite pool of animation energy. The user distributes kinetic energy between both characters using sliders and buttons, controlling animation speed, blend weights, and playback direction. An energy conservation law ensures the total animation energy always sums to 100 units, and a full undo/redo history tracks every adjustment.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that loads kira.glb and horse.glb side by side on a ground plane. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 6) looking at the origin, with OrbitControls. Add ambient light (intensity 0.6) and a directional light from (5, 10, 7) with intensity 1.2 casting shadows. Both models should have their AnimationMixers initialized and play all embedded clips simultaneously. Implement an energy conservation system: a shared pool of exactly 100 energy units distributed between Kira and the horse. Create an HTML overlay panel with: (1) a range slider for Kira's energy allocation (0-100), which auto-adjusts the horse's allocation to maintain the 100-unit total; (2) a playback speed multiplier dropdown (0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x) for each character that scales within their energy budget; (3) a direction toggle button for each character (forward/reverse) that reverses timeScale sign; (4) a blend weight slider for each character controlling how strongly their animations play (0.0 to 1.0), where blend weight multiplied by speed cannot exceed their energy allocation; (5) an Undo button and a Redo button that track all slider, dropdown, and toggle changes in a history stack (minimum 20 levels deep). Each interaction step modifies the animation state: adjusting energy distribution, changing speed, toggling direction, adjusting blend weights. Display a real-time HUD showing each character's current energy, effective speed, direction arrow, blend weight, and total energy (must always read 100). When a character's energy reaches zero, freeze their animation entirely. Color-code each character's energy bar (blue for Kira, green for horse). The ground plane should be a 10x10 grid with subtle shadow receiving. Ensure all 10-14 interaction steps are meaningful and that undo/redo correctly restores every parameter to its prior state.
